'''Telo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he was seen at the entrance of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], talking with [[Kehel]] and [[Nataya]].
